description: CVE reference data for the agent - these are the vulnerabilities most likely to come up based on current threat intel

cve_entries.name: Log4Shell
cve_entries.description: Remote code execution bug in Apache Log4j. Massive impact in 2021, still being exploited. Attacker just sends a crafted string and can run code remotely.
mitigations: Use WAF rules to block JNDI strings

cve_entries.name: EternalBlue
cve_entries.description: The SMBv1 exploit used by WannaCry ransomware. Old but still relevant because a lot of systems never got patched.

cve_entries.name: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset
cve_entries.description: DDoS vulnerability in HTTP/2 - attacker keeps sending RST_STREAM frames to overwhelm the server.

cve_entries.name: Confluence OGNL Injection
cve_entries.description: Unauthenticated remote code execution in Atlassian Confluence - no login needed to exploit this.

cve_entries.name: Outlook Zero-Click RCE
cve_entries.description: Zero-click Outlook vulnerability - attacker just sends an email and steals NTLM hashes without the user doing anything.
mitigations: Add Protected Users group for sensitive accounts
